summary: Across three recorded sessions, the amount of work shifted in shape rather than simply growing. The first session ran 54 turns across 13 episodes, with verification work spanning two episodes and 16 turns. The third session covered 46 turns across 20 episodes, and planning work in that session spanned seven episodes and 12 turns. The fourth session returned to 58 turns across 13 episodes, with planning work there spanning four episodes and 18 turns. Exploration work moved from a single seven-turn episode in the first session to a single one-turn episode in the third session, then to two episodes totaling seven turns in the fourth session.
